title: Dots
description: A song title set as a dot-matrix poster: every letter is drawn straight onto one strict grid of round dots, each stroke exactly two dots across, with curves and diagonals as solid 45-degree bands that step one dot sideways per dot row. Drag across it and a removal pattern sweeps through the word, alternate rows, then columns, then a chequerboard, then diagonals, each dot shrinking away or swelling back on its own spring as the front passes. The letters never move a dot; only which dots are present changes. Whatever is removed, one dot of every stroke survives, so each state is still a typeface. Let go and the pattern holds.
intent: After MuirMcNeil's TwoPoint type system (https://muirmcneil.com/project/twopoint/): one two-dot stroke form, with dot rows, columns or diagonals removed, and every variant sharing exact positions so styles swap without anything moving.
